meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: A goal-like loop that decomposes work into systematic, evidence-bound ultrawork steps. Use when the user wants a goal loop or durable, checkpointed execution.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把大目标拆成一步步可核对的执行,跑到一半也能存档接着跑
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常跑多步骤长任务,又希望中途能停、断了能接着跑
copy.tagline_en: Break a big goal into verifiable steps and run it through, resuming anytime
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run long multi-step tasks and want to pause and resume safely

howto.what: 把工作拆成极细颗粒的步骤:先注册目标并把每个动作同步到实时清单,每步用真实渠道留下可观察证据;状态存在 .omo/ulw-loop,上下文丢失后从断点继续而不重头规划。
howto.when: 当你提到 `ulw-loop`、`ulw` 等关键词,或要求目标循环、带检查点的长时间执行、需要手动 QA 与证据的工作时接管。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop 跑这个目标,先注册目标和成功标准。
say.note: 会先按 define-goal 建目标

say.text: 看一下当前 ulw-loop 的状态和下一步动作。
把这步的证据在当前 HEAD 上重跑并重新记录。

howto.what_en: Breaks work into ultra-granular steps: registers the goal first, mirrors each action into a live checklist, ties every success criterion to real-surface evidence, and keeps state in .omo/ulw-loop so runs resume after context loss.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for `ulw-loop`, `ulw` etc., or want a goal loop, durable checkpointed execution, evidence-led work, or manual QA.

say_en.text: Run this goal with ulw-loop; register the goal and success criteria first.
Show the current ulw-loop status and next actions.
Re-run this step's evidence at the current HEAD and re-record it.
say_en.note: Evidence is bound to a git tree
